name: Thai basil beef with fried egg
steps: Stir-fry the garlic in a hot oiled wok until fragrant.
Add the minced beef and cook until browned.
Toss in the green beans, soy sauce, and fish sauce and stir-fry briefly.
Fold through the basil leaves until just wilted.
Serve over the cooked rice with a crisp fried egg on top.
